name: Icon button
summary: A square or circular button that shows only an icon. For compact, familiar actions like close, search or more.

anatomy.purpose: 44px minimum hit area, even if the icon is smaller.
20 to 24px glyph with a clear shape.
aria-label that names the action, since there is no visible text.
Shows the name on hover and focus for pointer and keyboard users.

variants.name: Outlined
variants.use: When the icon needs a visible boundary.

variants.name: Filled
variants.use: The main action of a compact surface.

whenToUse: The icon is universally understood: close, search, menu, share, delete.
Space is tight, such as toolbars and cards.
whenNotToUse: The meaning is not obvious: add a text label.
It is the main call to action: use a labeled button.

accessibility.focus: Visible focus ring around the full hit area.
notes: Always set aria-label or visually hidden text.
Hide the decorative SVG with aria-hidden=true.
A toggle icon button needs aria-pressed.

code.html:
<button class="ib" type="button" aria-label="Search">
  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5"/></svg>
</button>
<button class="ib ib--outlined" type="button" aria-label="Close">
  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg>
</button>
